pins.u-boot:
# U-Boot release used for the CC boot loader. cc/build.sh downloads the
# tarball and refuses it unless the SHA-256 matches.
version: 2026.07
url: https://ftp.denx.de/pub/u-boot/u-boot-2026.07.tar.bz2
sha256: 78e8bfc382fe388f9b55aa1daf8c563522a037779b5d4c349d1415e381f1243e
# Mirrors carrying the same tarball, tried in order when the URL above does
# not answer. The SHA-256 decides what is accepted, whichever host delivers it.
mirror: https://sources.buildroot.net/uboot/u-boot-2026.07.tar.bz2
mirror: https://sources.openwrt.org/u-boot-2026.07.tar.bz2
# Tag commit, for reference; the tarball matches it apart from lib/lwip dot-files.
commit: ece349ade2973e220f524ce59e59711cc919263f
# Build timestamp fixed to the tag commit date, so the version string that
# U-Boot measures into PCR 0 is the same on every build.
source_date_epoch: 1783381843
